review.posthog_relevance: Adds a timeline view and confidence badge to the Replay Vision recording interface, replacing an older headline implementation.
review.reason: The chunk is dominated by snapshot and story changes, but P1.F8.H1 demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation change: removing the old ObservationHeadline and its associated badge while importing and using ObservationTimeline and ConfidenceBadge. This represents a UI behavior and correctness improvement rather than a narrow maintenance or documentation-only change. No tier
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of the ObservationTimeline and ConfidenceBadge components, and P1.F11.H2 and P1.F12.H1 are only story and test changes, not shared implementation. The tier is assigned based on P1.F8.H1, but the full benefit and systemic change cannot be verified without the implementation hunks.
